initialPrompts.hero: Use case: illustration-story. Asset type: original portrait key art for a polished anime magical tile-matching mobile game. Create an exquisite vertical 2:3 anime illustration, no text or UI. A kind young adult female star mage, long flowing pale lavender hair with pink highlights, expressive violet eyes, ivory and lavender modest flowing dress with navy ribbon and tiny gold celestial embroidery. She is standing on the right-center of the frame, shown knees-up, smiling softly, holding a small glowing crystal star in her palm. A tiny white floating cat spirit beside her. An enchanting sky-island garden and distant pale towers, luminous lavender dusk sky, peach clouds, stars and delicate flowers. Beautiful professional Japanese 2D animation key visual, delicate clean lineart, detailed hand-painted pastel scenery, light airy editorial composition, not plastic 3D. The top-left quarter mostly serene open lavender sky for a later game title; the bottom 20 percent is dreamy light lavender mist and soft flowers for later interface controls. Main character's face around x 64 percent y 35 percent. Overall ivory, periwinkle, blush, warm gold color harmony. Crisp luminous illustration with clear focal point, sophisticated restrained detail. Full bleed portrait. No words, no letters, no logo, no watermark, no borders, no existing franchise characters.
initialPrompts.items: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: one production sprite atlas for an original anime celestial tile-matching game. Square image, exactly 3 by 3 regular equal-sized grid cells, nine isolated magical object illustrations, actual transparent background. One icon perfectly centered in each cell; each icon entirely contained in central 65 percent of its cell, very generous equal transparent gutters. No tile backplates, no frames, no labels, no letters, no text, no shadows that cross cells. Order left-to-right then top-to-bottom: 1 a plump golden five-pointed wishing star with small orange gem; 2 a lavender crescent moon with tiny hanging golden charm; 3 a pink five-petal sakura blossom; 4 a bright cyan cut crystal gemstone; 5 a pale mint green stylized feather; 6 a small peach pink heart-shaped potion bottle with gold stopper; 7 an ivory white cat face with violet ears and expressive eyes; 8 a coral red satin bow with tiny gold star in center; 9 a royal blue magical book with gold celestial cover. Make all nine silhouettes immediately distinct. Matching beautiful hand-painted Japanese anime game inventory icon style, elegant clean dark-lavender contours, luminous soft shading, pastel highlights, rich saturated centers, visually legible at 48 pixels. Uniform icon scale, frontal view. Transparent background, no checkerboard pattern, no words or watermarks. This is an atlas of individual assets, not a screenshot of a game.

assets.prompt: Use case: style-transfer. Edit the reference illustration into a MUCH CUTER, simpler cartoon anime mobile game key visual. Preserve the celestial island garden concept, lavender-haired mage and white cat companion, and purple-pink-mint palette, but completely transform rendering and proportions: adorable CHIBI heroine, big round head, two-and-a-half-heads tall body, oversized happy violet eyes, tiny hands, round white kitten, chunky simplified shapes, soft thick purple outline, flat clean pastel cel shading with gentle gradients. Cheerful sunny magical clouds, little floating islands, chunky yellow stars, candy pink flowering trees. Joyful inviting and uncluttered, like an excellent cozy casual puzzle game illustration. No realistic human anatomy, no ornate embroidery, no dense fantasy detail, no semi-realistic painting. The chibi heroine and kitten occupy center-right, full figure, between 35 and 75 percent down the canvas. Keep top 28 percent mostly very light lilac sky with a few airy stars for title overlay, and bottom 20 percent pale pink cream mist for interface. Portrait 2:3 full bleed. No text, no watermark, no UI. Make this obviously cartoon and adorable.

Use case: style-transfer. Edit the reference sprite atlas into much simpler, rounder, cuter CARTOON game icons. Preserve exactly 3 by 3 grid, same nine object identities and same ordering: gold star, purple crescent, pink sakura; cyan crystal, mint feather, pink heart potion; white cat face, coral bow, blue book. Each object centered in its equal-sized cell, fits within central 72 percent of cell, generous transparent gutters on all sides. Actual transparent background. Strong rounded purple outlines, simple soft cel shading, candy colors, plump toy-like forms, a few large shiny highlights. Cute joyful cozy puzzle-game aesthetic. Remove elaborate gold filigree, tiny jewelry, tiny stars, realistic fur and excessive detail. Each icon must be immediately readable at 48px. The cat face especially round and cute with tiny pink nose and simple large violet eyes. Clean production atlas, no text, no tile backgrounds, no frames, no checkerboard, no watermark. Square composition.
